card.title: Microsoft 365 integrations
card.hint: Provisioning from Entra ID, the Outlook add-in, the Teams app, SharePoint and OneDrive.
card.active: {count, plural, =0 {None switched on} one {# integration on} other {# integrations on}}

admin.title: Microsoft 365 integrations
admin.subtitle: Each integration is switched on separately. Add the app registration first, then follow the steps in order.

app.title: 1. Microsoft app registration
app.hint: In the Entra admin center (App registrations › New registration) create one app for the organization. SharePoint, OneDrive and group data are read with it.
app.tenantHint: GUID or a verified domain, e.g. contoso.onmicrosoft.com
app.testNoRoles: Connected, but no application permission is granted.
app.permissionsBody: Add application permissions and grant admin consent:
app.permFiles: Files.ReadWrite.All: OneDrive mounts and the move tool
app.permGroups: GroupMember.Read.All: groups of people in more than 200 groups (Entra sign-in)

entra.title: Entra ID: sign-in and provisioning (SCIM)
entra.hint: People are created and disabled from Entra, and their groups map to roles.
entra.step1: Add the Entra ID identity provider (OIDC) in Admin › Integrations. Write the group mappings there; a group name or an Entra object ID works.
entra.step2: Switch this integration on and create a SCIM token below.
entra.step3: In Entra open Enterprise applications › your app › Provisioning › Automatic. Enter the SCIM address as Tenant URL and the token as Secret Token, then test the connection.
entra.step4: Add people and groups to the scope and start provisioning. A person disabled in Entra is suspended in Crewhall and signed out.
entra.noProvider: Add an Entra ID (OIDC) or SAML provider first.
entra.tokenOnce: This token is shown only now. Paste it into Entra.
entra.revokeBody: Entra can no longer create or disable people with this token.
entra.provisioned: {count, plural, one {# person managed by SCIM} other {# people managed by SCIM}}, {n} disabled
entra.caBody: Entra conditional access rules apply when signing in to Crewhall (MFA, compliant device, location). A blocked sign-in is explained on the sign-in page. Continuous access evaluation (CAE) is not supported; for short sessions use the session length in Admin › Security.

outlook.title: Outlook add-in
outlook.hint: Turns attachments into Drive links, adds an upload link and saves mail to Crewhall.
outlook.step1: Switch the add-in on; Crewhall creates an OIDC client for it.
outlook.step3: In the Microsoft 365 admin center go to Settings › Integrated apps › Upload custom apps, upload the manifest and assign it to people.
outlook.step4: In Outlook a "Save to Crewhall" button appears while reading and a "Crewhall link" button while writing. On first use people sign in with their Crewhall account.

teams.title: Teams app
teams.hint: Share Crewhall files and pages in Teams, save a message to Crewhall, a page or board as a tab.
teams.step1: Create an Azure Bot resource in the Azure portal (free F0). Enter the address below as its messaging endpoint and add the Microsoft Teams channel.
teams.step2: Enter the bot's Microsoft App ID here and switch the app on.
teams.step3: Download the app package and add it in the Teams admin center under Teams apps › Manage apps › Upload.
teams.step4: On their first search people choose "Connect your Crewhall account" and sign in once.
teams.linked: {count, plural, one {# person connected} other {# people connected}}

storage.title: External storage: SharePoint, OneDrive and SMB
storage.hint: Mount a SharePoint library, a OneDrive or a Windows share into a space's Drive. Files are not copied; they open where they are.
storage.step1: SharePoint and OneDrive need the app registration and its permissions. SMB needs a service account.
storage.step2: Switch the integration on, add the mount and pick the space it appears in. Members of the space see it, editors can upload.
storage.name: Display name
storage.deleteBody: Files stay at the source; only the mount in Crewhall is removed.
storage.moveHint: Each person's OneDrive is copied into their own personal space with the same folders. Nothing is deleted from OneDrive.
storage.moveStarted: {count, plural, one {# move started} other {# moves started}}
storage.jobLine: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}, {n} skipped
